slug: 2025-08-02 Benin - ANIP unveils digital platforms to modernise the electoral process

facts.fact: The government says ANIP presented its digital platforms built on the Registre National des Personnes Physiques, affirmed as the single source of electoral data under articles 41-42 of law 2017-08.
The government says the electoral process draws its data from the RNPP as the single source of electoral data, with platforms to find an NPI and view or change a polling station.
